_readme: Local models served by Ollama (aos install local). The only file in this repo that names models.
default: the local brain; change it only with `aos local adopt <tag>` after `aos nar eval` passes.
optional: other models aos install local keeps pulled (none now; the default qwen3.5:4b also reads images).
candidates: tags for the next bake-off; pulled by hand (`ollama pull <tag>`), not by aos.
